title: P0-R recovery overlay preserves the existing proof methods
question: Can the long-running Pre-A and Sector-A research be made exactly resumable while keeping every existing forward proof method unchanged and operating the observation-first inverse lane only as an additive parallel lane?
method: Audit the live Git, queue, doctor, release, task, gate, result, negative, exploration and changelog state and distinguish a verified pending worktree from durable local and remote Git authority.
Hash-pin the issued Sector-A, Pre-A forward, QFT bridge, Lane H/F/Q, A13 route-reset, inverse, holdout and external-interface authorities without copying their matrices.
Register P0-R through P7 as resume checkpoints only, with an explicit invariant that the underlying proof authorities retain their content, order and scientific meaning.

Register stable blocker fingerprints and exact reopen conditions so physical-empty, A13 local-coordinate, Q3LOCK finite-table, static-to-dynamics and generic owner-search loops remain parked without new inputs.

Run the ordinary continuity validator and a hostile self-test covering method replacement, authority drift, illegal phase transitions, evidence promotion, target-role conflation, repeated blockers, dirty baselines and remote mismatch.
Prepare the first post-P0-R packet as a paired source-owned dynamics and candidate-neutral temporal-observable intake, without selecting or changing an existing candidate method.
finding: The ordinary continuity contract passes with two lanes, eight resume checkpoints, thirteen immutable authority pointers, six semantic authority pointers and five stopped-loop fingerprints. Its hostile self-test rejects 23/23 mutations. Doctor and release checks pass at the recovery-start snapshot, but P0-R remains RECOVERY_IN_PROGRESS because the audited worktree had 21 queued requests, 176 unstaged tracked paths, 239 untracked paths, seven local commits beyond the tracking ref, and no live-remote equality proof. T-060 owns recovery; T-061 is registered only as the next paired intake packet. No existing proof method, claim, scientific gate or tier is changed.
decision_reason: The durable advance is a pointer-only resume and loop-control layer, not a replacement proof architecture. It preserves the prior forward programmes as controlling authorities, adds the inverse lane independently, and makes failure to commit or push visible rather than mistaking a release PASS for durable completion. P0-R cannot close until watcher drain, clean-tree, live-remote equality and a strict baseline pass are recorded.

adversarial_review.check: The user explicitly rejected rewriting the established research methods; four machine-enforced preservation flags make issued authorities controlling and return conflicts to P0-R.
Release PASS is kept distinct from commit-queue drain, clean Git state and remote equality.
The inverse lane is additive, uses separate lineage, and can report only compatibility or an equivalence class until its full map and independent holdout close.
Five blocker fingerprints remain PARKED and require a new hash-pinned input or named uniform theorem before reactivation.
Clean tree, queue zero and live remote equality are excluded from the ordinary release gate and enforced only by the post-push strict mode.
TECT-YM and external interface records remain hash-pinned locators and cannot bear a TECT claim.
The four evidence layers and three independent scope axes remain fail-closed; the recovery and successor packet are T0 and claim-nonbearing.

assumptions: The issued strategy records identified by hash remain the detailed method authorities.
Mutable task, gate, result and theorem-map files are validated by semantic IDs rather than whole-file hashes.
The audited dirty worktree belongs to the existing queued research batch and contains no concurrent unknown writer.
The configured push remote is tect and the target branch is main.
missing_assumptions: A drained commit queue and clean post-commit worktree.
A successful push and live remote refs/heads/main equality check.
One source-owned complete microscopic dynamics and four-stage observation map.
Observation source hashes, covariance or likelihood intake and an actual opaque prospective commitment.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing research-continuity and route-selection evidence only. P0-R is not yet complete. This record changes no existing proof method and proves no Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, physical-empty, continuum, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, physical mass gap, cosmic-origin or theory-of-everything statement.
decision_scope: Repository continuity overlay, recovery-start audit, stopped-loop registry and first successor intake packet only.
next_action: Regenerate all reader surfaces, rerun ordinary continuity, doctor, release and diff checks, drain the accumulated watcher queue as one verified batch, push main, verify the live remote head, and only then append the P0-R completion checkpoint and activate T-061.
no_overclaim: A durable research method and a passing contract validator do not advance the underlying mathematics or physics. The current scientific state remains zero admitted microscopic inverse maps and no owner-complete forward dynamics.
